messages:
morgan: heads-up - customer tenant-881 seeing SCIM 403s after yesterday's KMS rotate. Looks like provisioner can't decrypt stored service tokens.

morgan: paste from provisioner log:
```
2026-03-22T23:07:58Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: Authentication tag mismatch
 tenant=tenant-881 req_id=ff12ab
```

raj: which KMS/key alias did we rotate? any rewrap job for extids?

morgan: aws kms, alias `alias/redwood-scim` -> `alias/redwood-scim-2026-03-22`. We ran the rotation and queued a rewrap for active tenants but looks like tenant-881 tokens were missed.

elaine: quick triage: 1) confirm IAM principal used by provisioner retains kms:Decrypt on the new key and any key policy updates; 2) check if ciphertexts were rewrapped with the previous key material (possible race).

sre-oncall: also check cluster role-binding change log. We had a cleanup job that dropped stale bindings last night, could have removed the `scim-provisioner` service account binding to the secrets operator.

raj: I see PR 5147 deleted rolebinding with label `owner=bootstrap`. that affected `infra:scim-provisioner`. Could be the same.

morgan: confirmed: rolebinding removed. Recreated the k8s rolebinding and re-granted the IAM policy to the service account using our IRSA workflows. Restarted pods.

morgan: after restart, decrypt test succeeded locally: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://enc_blob --key-id alias/redwood-scim-2026-03-22 --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode` returned token.

elaine: good. next steps: run an audit query for CloudTrail events with eventName = Decrypt and errorCode != null around the rotation window to enumerate impacted tenants. Also run `scim:Provision` failure counts per-tenant.

sre-oncall: created dashboard tile `scim.decrypt.errors` and a timeboxed pager suppression for the ongoing mitigation. capture correlation ids for CS.

morgan: kicking off a replay/backfill: `./bin/scim-backfill --tenant tenant-881 --from 2026-03-22T23:00Z`

raj: note for postmortem: add a check in the rotation runbook to ensure rolebindings are not pruned by cleanup flows during rotation. Maybe add a locking tag on rolebinding objects.

elaine: also add a post-rotation audit step: verify at least one successful decrypt per active tenant and no Decrypt errors in CloudTrail.

morgan: backfill completed: 128 users re-provisioned, no further errors. Marking this resolved and will file a blameless postmortem with runbook updates. :white_check_mark:
